step1_analysis.description: A standard CMOS 2-input NAND gate. In the context of a DLL/VCO, it is typically used as a logic element in the phase-frequency detector (PFD), control logic, or as a delay cell in a voltage-controlled delay line (VCDL).

paper_reference.title: Techniques for Phase Noise Suppression in Recirculating DLLs

Propagation Delay (tpHL, tpLH).description: Time delay from the input crossing 50% of VDD to the output crossing 50% of VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: R_nmos ~ 270 ohm, R_pmos ~ 1.45 kohm. C_out ~ 55fF. tpHL ~ 0.69 * (2*270) * 55fF ~ 20ps. tpLH ~ 0.69 * 1450 * 55fF ~ 55ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on RC time constants of W=5u L=0.5u transistors in SKY130. The gate must be fast enough to support the 160 MHz system frequency.

Rise and Fall Times (tr, tf).description: Time taken for the output to transition between 20% and 80% of VDD.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using 2.2*RC with estimated parasitic and load capacitances.

Logic Threshold Voltage (Vth).description: Input voltage at which the input equals the output (V_in = V_out).

sky130_expected.calculation: Beta ratio (NMOS/PMOS) ~ 2.7 due to higher electron mobility, pulling the switching threshold below VDD/2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The NMOS pull-down network is stronger than the PMOS pull-up network, skewing the threshold lower than the ideal 0.9V.
Dynamic power dominates at high frequencies. Calculated based on a 250MHz toggle rate.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure propagation delay, rise/fall times, logic threshold, and power of the NAND gate.
step3_testbench.spice:
* NAND Gate Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N3 B GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUT A N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 OUT A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUT B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VB B 0 DC 1.8
VA A 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 2n 4n)
Cload OUT 0 10f

.control
  * DC Analysis for Logic Threshold
  dc VA 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc vth_logic when v(OUT)=0.9
  
  * Transient Analysis for Delay and Power
  tran 10p 8n
  meas tran tplh trig v(A) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran tphl trig v(A) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 fall=1
  meas tran trise trig v(OUT) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=1.44 rise=1
  meas tran tfall trig v(OUT) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.36 fall=1
  
  meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=8n
  print avg_current
  quit
.endc
.end
